children: GameSquare entered into a Contribution Agreement to acquire substantially all assets of FanEngine through a subsidiary. At closing, FanEngine securityholders will receive new GameSquare shares equal to 30% of the company’s outstanding stock, subject to shareholder approval. Additional consideration includes up to 10% more shares tied to revenue milestones and up to $50 million in cash based on Earnout Net Income. Buyer will assume limited liabilities, and closing is conditioned on Nasdaq Rule 5635(a) stockholder approval.
